adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new Salesforce refresh logic calls `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` directly (no use of the newly added `refreshOAuthTokens` helper), so even when `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` is configured it will not use the sync endpoint. Additionally it passes the response through `parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)`, whose implementation switches to the sync-mode `minimumTokenResponseSchema` whenever `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`—even though the response here is from Salesforce, not the sync endpoint. That makes behavior incorrect/inconsistent under sync mode and can cause validation failures if the Salesforce refresh response doesn’t match the minimum schema assumptions.
